summary: Implements approval modal for grilling workflow artifacts. Solid architecture with comprehensive testing (14 Go tests + 8 TypeScript A1 tests). However, three issues require fixes before merge: race condition risk in artifact paths, fragile spec extraction logic, and hard-coded repo root path.
strengths: Solid state machine for sequential review (context → spec)
Comprehensive test coverage including AC1/AC2 and edge cases
Proper error handling with GrillingArtifactsCommitErr type
Clear data contract with GrillingArtifacts struct

issues.description: Multiple grilling workflows in same repo could overwrite artifacts at .git/common/agent-flow/grilling/{context|spec}.md
issues.recommendation: Add workflow ID to artifact paths: .git/common/agent-flow/grilling/{runId}-{artifact}.md

issues.description: Spec extraction uses substring matching (What, -) which may miss complex requirements or catch false positives
issues.recommendation: Use LLM-based extraction or sophisticated pattern matching for spec generation

issues.description: writeArtifact always uses repo-root/, ignoring user config for custom working directories
issues.recommendation: Accept optional path parameter or use config from modal context

reviewer_notes: The implementation is well-architected and thoroughly tested. The three issues above are fixable without breaking changes: (1) add runId to artifact paths for race safety, (2) enhance spec extraction with smarter heuristics or LLM fallback, (3) make output path configurable. These can be addressed in a follow-up commit after initial merge.
